messages:
maya: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a replay-run for last week's peak traces to validate kernel selection changes. Need quick sanity check on sampling config before I run the cluster. Plan: anonymize -> sample 2% stratified by model + seq_len -> deterministic seed -> run with both kernel A and kernel B, KV warmup disabled then enabled. Anyone available?
josh: 👍 what's the deterministic seed? also what's the sample size in absolute queries?
maya: seed=42 (for now). 2% ~ 120k requests across the trace. I'll also try 0.5% for smoke.
liam: careful: earlier we saw bias with short-seq overrepresentation when we used uniform sampling. Stratify by buckets: <64, 64-256, >256 and weight by traffic share.
nora: agree. Also need to scrub PII: remove prompt embeddings and username fields. replay-bot has an anonymize step but verify configs.
chen: config snippet -> ```yaml
sample_strategy: stratified
buckets: ["<64","64-256","256+"]
fractions: [0.5,0.35,0.15]
determinism_seed: 42
anonymize: true
drop_fields: ["user_id","email","prompt_metadata"]
```
maya: thx. also toggling KV warmup matters — if we start with cold cache we saw ~12% slower tail latency. I want two runs: cold and prewarmed using our warmup script.
josh: for kernel selection parity: run with `--kernel-policy=auto` vs `--kernel-policy=legacy` and use identical batching heuristics: `--batch-max-tokens=4096 --batch-window-ms=3`.
nora: add telemetry tags so we can slice by kernel and warmup: `X-Run-Id`, `X-Kernel-Policy`, `X-Prewarm`. Will make post-run diffs easier.
chen: small perf regression note: last week's canary showed 4% token/sec drop on policy=auto for model-x when seq_len>512. We should capture kernel-level counters (matmul_time, softmax_time) and kv-hits.
maya: I'll kick off smoke in staging at 10:30. If green, full run at 11:00. Posting the run command in case someone wants to reproduce: ```bash
./replay_runner --trace=/mnt/traces/2026-03-08.gz --sample=0.02 --seed=42 --anonymize --kernel-policy=auto --batch-max-tokens=4096 --batch-window-ms=3 --telemetry-tag=X-Run-Id:2334501234
```
infra-bot: Scheduled: replay-run-2334501234 in staging at 2026-03-10T10:30:00Z. ETA ~ 45m for smoke.
replay-bot: Anonymization summary: removed 3.1M fields, hashed 120k session ids. Hash salt id: s-9a7c. Check `/ops/replay/anonymization/2334501234/report.json`
maya: results: smoke passed. Cold run shows tail p99 +10% for kernel=auto; prewarmed run p99 delta +2%. Kernel counters show softmax increased ~18% time on auto for long sequences. Uploading profiles.
josh: thanks. can you push profiles and the apples-to-apples diff to the perf dashboard? I'll triage whether it's a kernel fallback bug or batching interaction.
maya: pushed: /perf/runs/2334501234/ (profiles, diffs, raw telemetry). Action items: 1) liam to re-eval stratified fractions 2) chen to extract kernel counters for long-seq hotpath 3) nora to sanity-check anonymization report. I'll open follow-up thread if we need more runs.
nora: noted, will check anonymization report and confirm no residual PII.
liam: I'll run a synthetic microbenchmark focusing on >512 seq with smaller batch-window to see if batching window is causing softmax blowup.
